_comment: North and East Indian chart geometry (FUN_00437e40, FUN_004362d0). Run once per ChartStyle 2, 3, 4 into its own directory: --ini ChartStyle=N --out golden/jhora-chartstyle<N> (GDI draws of the Many Vargas boxes, standard view). Restore ChartStyle=0 afterwards (--ini ChartStyle=0 on the next run). tests/chartStylesGolden.test.ts skips while these directories are absent; it also reads the style draws of golden/jhora-chartviews-style<N> (views-chartviews.json) when present.
